permit.applies: The worker or the hiring company applies to the Servei d'Immigració within the general quota of residence and work authorisations the Government sets by decree.
permit.first: An authorisation still available within the general quota (the number of authorisations a company may receive is capped), and pay of at least the occupation's immigration salary class.

fees.what: Short-duration work fee (an engagement of 5 working days or more within the 30-day exemption)

permit.pay: At least the salary of the occupation's Classificació salarial d'immigració (CSI) for a 40-hour week; under Decree 350/2021, group 25 (writers, artists and similar professionals) was 1,351 € a month (the current Decree 335/2025's table wasn't read).
permit.feesNote: The amounts Llei 10/2018 set in article 154 of Llei 9/2012; the law lets the annual budget law update them, and no later update was read.
permit.validityNote: An initial year, renewed three times for two years each, then for ten years at a time after seven years.
permit.exemptNote: Hiring the services of a foreign company or a self-employed foreign professional for no more than 30 calendar days in a calendar year needs no immigration authorisation, only a prior written notice to the Servei d'Immigració, and the short-duration fee when the engagement is 5 working days or more. It covers a performer engaged as a self-employed professional, not one hired as an employee.
